description: Controlled synthetic fixtures for checking LLM explanation behavior. These are not real HDFS incident records and must not be used as model-performance data.

scenarios.description: Anomaly prediction with only two limited log records; root cause is not established.
log_lines: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: NameSystem.delete operation observed for block.
SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: block blk_quality_sparse_001 added to invalidSet.
scenarios.purpose: A high classifier score must not force high explanation confidence when evidence is sparse.

scenarios.description: Several coherent synthetic records describe a sequence, but do not prove the underlying root cause.
log_lines: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: block blk_quality_sequence_002 received by DataNode.
SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: checksum verification failed for block blk_quality_sequence_002.
SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: block blk_quality_sequence_002 marked for invalidation.
scenarios.purpose: The explanation may describe the observed sequence, but must not assert an unproven root cause.

scenarios.description: Normal classifier result with routine synthetic records.
log_lines: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: block blk_quality_normal_003 replication completed.
scenarios.purpose: The LLM must preserve the normal classifier result and avoid relabeling the block.

scenarios.description: High anomaly score with generic records that do not explain a specific cause.
log_lines: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: INFO service heartbeat received.
SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: INFO periodic status update completed.
scenarios.purpose: The LLM must acknowledge that the supplied records do not explain the anomaly.

scenarios.description: Synthetic records contain apparently conflicting status messages.
log_lines: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: block blk_quality_ambiguous_005 marked invalid.
SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: block blk_quality_ambiguous_005 reported as finalized.
scenarios.purpose: The LLM must surface ambiguity instead of choosing an unsupported interpretation.
